settings.question: Do you offer dropshipping?
settings.answer: Yes. During the checkout process, you can select the dropship option and provide the recipient’s address.

settings.question: How long will delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery times vary depending on location and shipping method. Most orders are processed within 1–2 business days. You will receive a tracking number once your order has shipped.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Currently, we ship within Canada only.

settings.question: How do I create an account?
settings.answer: Click on the “Sign Up” button on the top right corner of our website. Fill out the required information and submit your request. Once your account is approved, you can start placing orders.

settings.question: Do I have to pay to create an account?
settings.answer: Nope! Creating an Ink Quest account is totally free. You only pay when you order.

settings.question: Can I place an order without an account?
settings.answer: No. An approved account is required to place orders to ensure secure transactions and accurate order tracking.

settings.question: Do I need to meet a minimum order amount?
settings.answer: No minimums! You can order as little or as much as you need.

settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer: After logging in, browse our online catalogue, select the products you need, and add them to your cart. Follow the checkout process to complete your purchase.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Eligible items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Products must be unused, in original condition, and in their original packaging.

settings.question: Are there items that cannot be returned?
settings.answer: Yes. Custom or altered products, clearance/final sale items, and perishable goods are not eligible for returns.

settings.question: How do I initiate a return?
settings.answer: Contact our support team via email or phone to request a return. We will provide instructions and a return authorization if your item is eligible.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept credit cards, e-transfer, EFT, Bill Payment and Cheque for approved business accounts. Please note that e-transfers are not accepted.

settings.question: Can I get a copy of my invoice?
settings.answer: Yes. Invoices are automatically emailed to you after each purchase

settings.question: Do you carry compatible and original ink cartridges?
settings.answer: Yes. Ink Quest offers both original brand cartridges and high-quality compatible alternatives.

settings.question: How often do you update your product catalog?
settings.answer: We add new products daily to ensure our customers have access to the latest and most compatible printer ink and accessories.

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.description: Find answers to common questions about our products and services
settings.answer_1: We offer a 30-day return policy on all items. Products must be in original condition with tags attached.
settings.answer_2: Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping options are available at checkout.
settings.answer_3: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping times vary by location.
settings.question_4: How can I track my order?
settings.answer_4: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can use this to track your package.
settings.question_5: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer_5: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and other secure payment methods.
settings.question_6: How do I contact customer support?
settings.answer_6: You can reach our customer support team via email or phone. We're available Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm.
